citation: Mikofski, Meyers and Chaudhari (2018). PVMismatch Project. SunPower Corporation. https://github.com/SunPower/PVMismatch
description: PVMismatch is SunPower's Python calculator for current-voltage and power-voltage curves in photovoltaic circuits. Its hierarchy builds cells into cell strings, modules, strings and systems to examine electrical mismatch. Inputs include cell technology, effective irradiance, cell temperature, bypass-device configuration and cell-string layout; outputs are the resulting circuit curves. Spatial coverage follows the selected photovoltaic assembly, while operating conditions are specified by the user, not a supplied weather period. Source is free under BSD-3-Clause and distributed through PyPI, with NumPy, SciPy and matplotlib dependencies. A limitation is that the model requires suitable cell and operating-condition assumptions; it does not supply a measured installation inventory or independently establish annual energy yield. The code supports photovoltaic loss and design simulations. Solcore (platform-solcore) is a related solar-device modelling package. The maintainers provide a software citation and links to mismatch-loss studies. No model was run.
